title: Modern Robotics: Mechanics, Planning, and Control (Kevin M. Lynch, Frank C. Park) — updated first-edition preprint, Dec 30, 2019
reliability_notes: Primary source of record per the research plan. Read directly with pdftotext (poppler, installed this round after the environment initially lacked pdftotext/pdftoppm) across pages 1-9 (front-matter table of contents) and 14-18 (preface). This is the authoritative ground truth for the book's own structure, not a claim requiring external corroboration. Confirmed: 644 pages, PDF metadata shows CreationDate Jan 5 2020, producer pdfTeX; text explicitly self-identifies as the 'Dec 2019 preprint of updated first edition of Modern Robotics, 2017' published by Cambridge University Press (original ISBN 9781107156302, 3rd-printing-2019-or-later matches this text). Confirmed chapter list (13 numbered chapters + 4 appendices + bibliography + index), matching but not identical in pagination to the public MIT/Northwestern syllabus commonly cited online — this PDF read directly is more authoritative than that public syllabus for this user's specific copy.
key_claims_supported: Confirmed 13-chapter structure: 1 Preview; 2 Configuration Space; 3 Rigid-Body Motions; 4 Forward Kinematics; 5 Velocity Kinematics and Statics; 6 Inverse Kinematics; 7 Kinematics of Closed Chains; 8 Dynamics of Open Chains; 9 Trajectory Generation; 10 Motion Planning; 11 Robot Control; 12 Grasping and Manipulation; 13 Wheeled Mobile Robots

Confirmed major subsections per chapter (e.g. Ch.5 Manipulator Jacobian/Statics/Singularity/Manipulability; Ch.8 Lagrangian & Newton-Euler dynamics, actuation/gearing/friction; Ch.10 grid/sampling/RRT/PRM/potential-field planners; Ch.11 velocity- vs torque-input motion control, force control, impedance control; Ch.12 contact kinematics, friction, form/force closure; Ch.13 omnidirectional vs nonholonomic wheeled robots, odometry, mobile manipulation)
Confirmed appendices: A Summary of Useful Formulas; B Other Representations of Rotations; C Denavit-Hartenberg Parameters; D Optimization and Lagrange Multipliers; plus Bibliography and Index
Confirmed 644 total pages, updated first-edition preprint dated Dec 2019 / distributed Jan 2020, original Cambridge University Press 2017 publication

Authors' own stated prerequisite structure: Chapters 2-6 are 'the minimum essentials' and 'should probably be covered in sequence'; Chapter 8 (dynamics) is a prerequisite for standard treatments of Ch.9 (trajectory generation) and Ch.11 (robot control), though the authors note control/trajectory generation can be taught with velocity-only inputs if dynamics is skipped; various named university courses (Seoul National University, Northwestern) combine subsets of Ch.2-13 in different orders depending on focus (kinematics-only path: 2-7 and 13; planning-focused path: 2-3, 10, 13; manipulation-focused path: 2-6, 8, 12; control-focused path: 2-6, 8, 9, 11)
